ex.cn: 你并非蓄意伤害对手。

ex.en: I can say, with absolute truthfulness, that I did not injure her.
ex.cn: 我可以绝对坦率地说，我没有伤害她。

ex.en: He made a remarkable recovery from a shin injury.
ex.cn: 他的胫骨伤恢复得相当不错。

ex.en: The victim suffered a dreadful injury and lost a lot of blood.
ex.cn: 受害者受了重伤，大量失血。

phr.d: adj. 上墨，用墨水在添画
n. 假日酒店；假日旅馆

ex.en: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.
ex.cn: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总有种宾至如归的感觉。

ex.en: The inn gift shop stocks quality Indian crafts and sundries.
ex.cn: 旅馆的礼品店里备有上好的印度手工艺品和其他一些特色礼品。

ex.en: It is a neighborhood beset by all the usual inner-city problems.
ex.cn: 这是个为各种内城常见问题所困扰的社区。

ex.en: Once outside the inner breakwater, we began to unfurl all the sails.
ex.cn: 一驶出内防波堤，我们就扬起了所有的船帆。

phr.d: 无辜人的血；无辜之血；不死的传说（美国恐怖戏剧爱情片）
无过失之一方；无辜的一方

ex.en: Under all the innocent fun, there are hidden dangers, especially for children.
ex.cn: 在所有简单无害的娱乐项目背后都隐藏着危险，特别是对儿童而言。

ex.en: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
ex.cn: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

phr.d: 数据输入，资料输入；输入数据

ex.en: Edit the input text and re-run the software.
ex.cn: 修改输入的文本，重新运行软件。

ex.en: The Ministry of Agriculture commissioned a study into low-input farming.
ex.cn: 农业部委托对低投入耕作进行研究。

ex.en: Elsie called to inquire after my health.
ex.cn: 埃尔茜打电话来问候我。

ex.en: Inspectors were appointed to inquire into the affairs of the company.
ex.cn: 督查员受委派调查该公司的事务。

phr.d: 调查，查询；对…的调查；询问

ex.en: The government ordered an independent inquiry into the affair.
ex.cn: 政府下令对该事件进行独立调查。

ex.en: They needed more time to consider whether to hold an inquiry.
ex.cn: 他们需要更多的时间来考虑是否进行调查。

phr.d: 昆虫抗药性；防蛀性；耐虫性
昆虫咬伤；被虫咬伤；蚊虫叮咬

ex.en: Many kinds of insect find their mates by scent.
ex.cn: 许多昆虫通过气味找到交配对象。

ex.en: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
ex.cn: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

ex.en: Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
ex.cn: 把硬币放进投币口，按钮取票。

ex.en: I wish to insert an advertisement in your newspaper.
ex.cn: 我想在贵报上登一则广告.

phr.d: adv. 在里面；在内心；知道内情

ex.en: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
ex.cn: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

ex.en: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
ex.cn: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

phr.d: 坚持，坚决要求；督促，强调

ex.en: The psychologists insist, however, that they are not being prescriptive.
ex.cn: 然而，心理学家坚称他们并非一味灌输。

ex.en: They insist on tastier chocolate than the anaemic British stuff.
ex.cn: 他们坚持要比淡而无味的英国货味道更好的巧克力。

ex.en: Elaine went outside to inspect the playing field.
ex.cn: 伊莱恩走到外面查看操场。

ex.en: They have the right to come in and inspect the meter.
ex.cn: 他们有权进来查表。

ex.en: After an inspection, the inspectors must publish a report.
ex.cn: 在视察之后，视察者必须发表一份报告。

ex.en: He discovered, on closer inspection, that the rocks contained gold.
ex.cn: 经过更为仔细的探察，他发现这些岩石含金。

ex.en: These herbs will inspire you to try out all sorts of exotic-flavoured dishes!
ex.cn: 这些香草会激发你去品尝各种异国风味的菜肴！

ex.en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
ex.cn: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

ex.en: Another change that Sue made was to install central heating.
ex.cn: 休所作的另一个改变是安装中央供暖系统。

ex.en: The army has promised to install a new government within a week.
ex.cn: 军队已经许诺在一周内任命新一届政府。

phr.d: 安装与调试；安装调试人员
电气安装技术；电气装置

ex.en: All large ships now have a wireless installation.
ex.cn: 所有的大型船舶现在都有无线电装置.

ex.en: Installation of the new system will take several days.
ex.cn: 新系统的安装需要几天时间。

phr.d: （类的）实例；（某类别的） 实体

ex.en: It is not a unique instance , but has its counterpart.
ex.cn: 无独有偶.

ex.en: The rally was organised at the instance of two senior cabinet ministers.
ex.cn: 集会是应两位资深内阁大臣的要求组织的。

phr.d: 方便食品；即时食品；速溶食品

ex.en: I had bolted the door the instant I had seen the bat.
ex.cn: 我一看到蝙蝠就把门闩上了。

ex.en: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
ex.cn: 与此同时，他猛地推开了车门。

ex.en: Some styles are so flattering that they instantly become classics.
ex.cn: 有些款式特别衬人，很快就成了经典。

ex.en: He instantly grasped that Stephen was talking about his wife.
ex.cn: 他马上就明白斯蒂芬在说他的妻子。

ex.en: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
ex.cn: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

ex.en: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
ex.cn: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

ex.en: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists.
ex.cn: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。

ex.en: She hadn't followed her instinct and because of this Frank was dead.
ex.cn: 她没有听从自己心里的话，弗兰克因此死了。

phr.d: 工程学院；工业学院；工科院
孔子学院（非营利性公益机构）

ex.en: The Institute of Export now fears that 100,000 jobs will go.
ex.cn: 现在出口协会担心将失去10万个工作机会。

ex.en: He visited the Institute of Neurology in Havana where they both worked.
ex.cn: 他访问了两人都曾工作过的哈瓦那的神经病学研究所.

ex.en: The woman will be confined to a mental institution.
ex.cn: 这个女人将被关进精神病院。

ex.en: Congress as an institution scores low in public opinion polls.
ex.cn: 作为一个公共机构，国会在公众民意调查中得分很低。

ex.en: You can instruct your bank to allow a third party to remove money from your account.
ex.cn: 你可以通知银行，允许第三方从你的账户取款。

ex.en: We should instruct the passengers what customs regulations are.
ex.cn: 我们应该向乘客说明海关规则是什么.

phr.d: 安装手册，操作工序说明书；工艺规范

ex.en: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
ex.cn: 这一方法给教学带来了活力，也使知识的吸收变得容易了。

ex.en: The worst part of the set-up is the poor instruction manual.
ex.cn: 安装时最糟糕就是操作指南讲述不够清楚。

ex.en: The veto has been a traditional instrument of diplomacy for centuries.
ex.cn: 几个世纪以来否决权一直是外交上惯用的手段。

ex.en: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
ex.cn: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

ex.en: There is insufficient space for enlargement of the buildings.
ex.cn: 没有足够的空间扩建这些建筑。

ex.en: The judge finally concluded there was insufficient evidence of premeditation.
ex.cn: 法官最终作出判定，没有足够证据证明那是有预谋的。

phr.d: 雪上加霜；伤害之外又加侮辱

ex.en: She spat the name out like an insult.
ex.cn: 她像骂人似的说出了那个名字。

ex.en: Forgive me, I don't mean to insult you.
ex.cn: 请原谅，我并非有意侮辱你。

phr.d: 人寿保险；保险公司偿付的人寿金

ex.en: Police investigating a £10 million car insurance fiddle arrested 16 people yesterday.
ex.cn: 调查涉及1,000万英镑的汽车保险诈骗案的警察昨天逮捕了16人。

ex.en: She learned her insurance had been canceled by Pacific Mutual Insurance Company.
ex.cn: 她得知自己的保险已经被太平洋互助保险公司中止了。

ex.en: Think carefully before you insure against accident, sickness and redundancy.
ex.cn: 在为意外事故、疾病与失业投保之前一定要考虑清楚。

ex.en: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
ex.cn: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

phr.d: 世界知识产权组织（略作WIPO）

ex.en: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
ex.cn: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

ex.en: Sontag has always been that rarity, a glamorous intellectual.
ex.cn: 桑塔格一直是那种兼具美貌与智慧的人中龙凤。

phr.d: 情绪智力；情商；情绪智商

ex.en: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
ex.cn: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

ex.en: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
ex.cn: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

ex.en: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
ex.cn: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

ex.en: She was thin and spare, with a sharply intelligent face.
ex.cn: 她又高又瘦，一副精明过人的模样。

ex.en: It's only fair to let her know that you intend to apply.
ex.cn: 告诉她你打算申请，这才算公平嘛。

ex.en: England intend fielding their strongest team in next month's World Youth Championship.
ex.cn: 英格兰意欲在下月的世界青年锦标赛中推出他们的最强阵容。

ex.en: I felt so self-conscious under Luke's mother's intense gaze.
ex.cn: 在卢克母亲审视的目光下，我感到极不自在。

ex.en: That was the cue for several months of intense bargaining.
ex.cn: 那意味着几个月的激烈谈判开始了。

phr.d: 劳动强度，劳力投入密集度
强度分布；强度分析；亮度分布

ex.en: The most visible sign of the intensity of the crisis is unemployment.
ex.cn: 预示危机严重程度的一个最显著的迹象就是失业情况。

ex.en: His intensity and the ferocity of his feelings alarmed me.
ex.cn: 他感情之激烈和狂暴都让我惊恐。

ex.en: Boren surprisingly led off the most intensive line of questioning today.
ex.cn: 博伦今天出人意料地一上来就开始连珠炮似地盘问起来。

ex.en: She spent the night in intensive care after the operation.
ex.cn: 手术后的那个夜晚她在重症监护病房度过。

ex.en: Giovanni plied him with questions with the intention of prolonging his stay.
ex.cn: 乔瓦尼一个劲儿地问他问题，想要拖住他。

ex.en: The president said he had no intention of deploying ground troops.
ex.cn: 总统称并不打算部署地面部队。

ex.en: She looked at him closely to see if his evasiveness was intentional.
ex.cn: 她端详着他，想要知道他是否故意回避。

ex.en: Civil disobedience, violent or non-violent, is intentional law breaking.
ex.cn: 公民抗命，不管是暴力还是非暴力的，都是故意犯法。

phr.d: 社会互动；社会干预；社会的相互作用

ex.en: The following excerpt is illustrative of her interaction with students.
ex.cn: 接下来的节选部分可以说明她与学生的互动情况。

ex.en: The interaction of the two groups produced many good ideas.
ex.cn: 两个组的相互交流产生了许多好主意.

ex.en: We have the interest of 500,000 customers to think of.
ex.cn: 我们得为50万名顾客的利益着想。

ex.en: Hopes of an early cut in interest rates bolstered confidence.
ex.cn: 利率有望早日下调，从而增强了人们的信心。

ex.en: You get an interesting meal for a reasonable price.
ex.cn: 你花不多的钱就可以吃一顿很特别的饭。

ex.en: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
ex.cn: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

phr.d: 干扰，干涉；妨碍；触动或弄坏；乱动；与……抵触

ex.en: He knew when to leave well alone and when to interfere.
ex.cn: 他知道什么时候该适可而止，什么时候该插手干预。

ex.en: Smoking and drinking interfere with your body's ability to process oxygen.
ex.cn: 抽烟与酗酒有碍身体处理氧气的能力。

phr.d: 过盈配合；干涉配合；紧配合

ex.en: The parliament described the decree as interference in the republic's internal affairs.
ex.cn: 议会形容此法令为对共和国内政的干涉。

ex.en: It is hard to imagine her taking kindly to too much interference.
ex.cn: 很难想象她会喜欢被人过多地干涉。

phr.d: 室内设计；室内装饰；内部装饰业

ex.en: The interior flatlands and valleys are thickly planted with coconuts.
ex.cn: 内陆的平地和山谷中种着茂密的椰子树。

ex.en: Interior decoration by careful coordination seems to have had its day.
ex.cn: 精心搭配的室内装饰似乎已不再受欢迎了。

phr.d: 中间产品；半成品；中间乘积
[计]中间阶段；[计]中间级；[医]中间期
化学半成品；化学中间体

ex.en: You should consider breaking the journey with intermediate stopovers at airport hotels.
ex.cn: 你应该考虑将旅程分为几段，中途在机场旅馆稍作停留。

ex.en: This country is now at an intermediate stage of development.
ex.cn: 这个国家目前正处于发展的中间阶段.

ex.en: It took internal whistle-blowing and investigative journalism to uncover the rot.
ex.cn: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。

ex.en: This cuttlefish has a horny internal shell like a pen.
ex.cn: 这只乌贼有一个笔状的角质内壳。

ex.en: International investors have become jittery about the country's economy.
ex.cn: 国际投资者已对该国的经济状况感到紧张不安。

ex.en: All cheques should be made out to "EF International Language Schools"
ex.cn: 所有支票的收款人都应是“英孚国际语言学校”。

ex.en: Historians annotate, check and interpret the diary selections.
ex.cn: 历史学家对日记选篇进行加注、核查以及阐释。

ex.en: They could interpret it that way if they'd a mind to.
ex.cn: 如果他们愿意的话，可以那样理解。

ex.en: Language interpretation is the whole point of the act of reading.
ex.cn: 阅读行为中关键在于对语言的理解。

ex.en: The opposition Conservative Party put a different interpretation on the figures.
ex.cn: 反对党保守党对这些数字提出一番不同的解释。

ex.en: The civil war claimed the life of a U.N. interpreter yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天，内战夺去了一位联合国译员的生命。

ex.en: He was an official interpreter to the government of Nepal.
ex.cn: 他曾是尼泊尔政府的官方译员。

ex.en: "If I may interrupt for a moment," Kenneth said.
ex.cn: “能打搅一下吗，”肯尼思说。

ex.en: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. "Sorry to interrupt, Colonel."
ex.cn: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下，上校。”

phr.d: 供电中断，电源中断；从电中断

ex.en: Motherhood did not constitute much of an interruption to her career.
ex.cn: 做母亲并没有在很大程度上中断她的事业。

ex.en: There was constant jeering and interruption from the floor.
ex.cn: 议员席上不断有人在嘲讽和打岔.

phr.d: 时时，不时；相隔一定距离（或时间）

ex.en: The goal that decided the match came just before the interval.
ex.cn: 决定本场比赛结果的进球是在中场休息前一刻打入的。

ex.en: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
ex.cn: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

phr.d: 个人面谈；面谈调查；私人的会谈

ex.en: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
ex.cn: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

ex.en: As mentioned earlier, the University supplements this information with an interview.
ex.cn: 如前所述，大学将通过面试对这一信息进行补充。

ex.en: France has kept the most intimate links with its former African territories.
ex.cn: 法国与其前非洲属地一直保持着最密切的联系。

ex.en: Mr Black went for the jugular, asking intimate sexual questions.
ex.cn: 布莱克先生直攻要害，问起了性方面的隐私问题。

ex.en: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.
ex.cn: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。

ex.en: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
ex.cn: 我尽量言简意赅。

ex.en: "Forgive my manners," she said calmly. "I neglected to introduce myself."
ex.cn: “请原谅我礼数不周，”她平静地说。“我忘了自我介绍了。”

ex.en: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
ex.cn: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

phr.d: 植物引入，植物引种；引进的植物

ex.en: On balance, the book is a friendly, down-to-earth introduction to physics.
ex.cn: 总而言之，这是一本通俗而务实的物理入门书。

ex.en: Millions of words have been written about the introduction of the euro.
ex.cn: 有关采用欧元的文章已经有很多。

ex.en: The press invade people's privacy unfairly and unjustifiably every day.
ex.cn: 新闻媒体每天都在不公正地且没有正当理由地侵犯人们的隐私。

ex.en: I don't want to invade your private life unnecessarily.
ex.cn: 我不想过多地干涉你的私生活.

phr.d: 侵犯个人隐私；侵犯隐私权

ex.en: When the invasion occurred he ruled as a puppet of the occupiers.
ex.cn: 外敌入侵时，他作为占领者的傀儡行使统治。

ex.en: The secrecy and swiftness of the invasion shocked and amazed army officers.
ex.cn: 这次入侵的隐秘和迅速令陆军军官们大为震惊。

ex.en: His father had helped invent a whole new way of doing business.
ex.cn: 他父亲帮助创造了一套全新的生意经。

ex.en: We have to invent a new method for sneaking prisoners out without being noticed by the guards.
ex.cn: 我们必须想出新的办法使囚犯们偷偷溜出去而不被看守发现.

ex.en: The new invention ensures the beer keeps a full, frothy head.
ex.cn: 这项新发明能保证啤酒始终保持丰富的泡沫。

ex.en: It's been a tricky business marketing his new invention.
ex.cn: 推广他的新发明一直是件棘手的事情。

ex.en: He became famous as an inventor of astonishing visual and aural effects.
ex.cn: 他因发明了神奇的视听效果而出名。

ex.en: The royalties enabled the inventor to re-establish himself in business.
ex.cn: 专利使用费让这位发明家得以再次立足于商界。

phr.d: v. 投资于；[口]买进；寄希望于

ex.en: Business is booming and foreigners are scrambling to invest.
ex.cn: 商业繁荣，外国人争相投资。

ex.en: They would have to offer cast-iron guarantees to invest in long-term projects.
ex.cn: 他们需提供绝对可靠的担保，才能投资长期项目。

ex.en: We were asked to investigate the alleged inconsistencies in his evidence.
ex.cn: 我们被要求对他证词中的前后矛盾之处进行调查。

ex.en: The two sides agreed to set up a commission to investigate claims.
ex.cn: 双方同意组建一个委员会来调查那些索赔要求。

ex.en: The allegations are serious enough to warrant an investigation.
ex.cn: 这些指控很严重，有必要进行一番调查。

ex.en: An investigation is underway to find out how the disaster happened.
ex.cn: 调查已经展开，以查明灾难是如何发生的。

ex.cn: 战争期间，琼帮妈妈给战士们织围巾。

ex.en: Top the steaming hot potatoes with a knob of butter.
ex.cn: 在冒热气的马铃薯上放一小块黄油。

ex.cn: 逆时针转动旋钮可以开启切割机。

phr.d: 敲空；击倒；打破；使筋疲力竭

ex.en: Find Bernie and get him to knock an agreement together.
ex.cn: 找到伯尼，让他尽快拟好一份协议。

ex.en: They decided to knock the two rooms into one.
ex.cn: 他们决定把两间屋子打通连成一间。

phr.d: 难题；戈尔迪之结（希腊神话中的一个难题）

ex.en: Len tied the knot with Kate five years ago.
ex.cn: 莱恩5年前和凯特结婚了。

ex.en: She wore a checked shirt tied in a knot above the navel.
ex.cn: 她身穿一件格子衬衫，衣角在肚脐上方打了个结。

phr.d: 了解，知道……的情况；知道关于
[口语][用作插入语]你也知道；你是知道的，不是吗?
◎知道是怎么回事，深知其中滋味

ex.en: I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
ex.cn: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

ex.en: We all know that fats spoil by becoming rancid.
ex.cn: 我们都知道油脂变质后会发臭。

ex.en: Father had no more than a superficial knowledge of music.
ex.cn: 父亲对音乐只懂一点皮毛。

ex.en: He did not get a chance to deepen his knowledge of Poland.
ex.cn: 他没有机会更深入地了解波兰。

phr.d: 媒体实验室；（美国麻省理工学院）媒体实验室
实验室技术员；实验技师

ex.en: "He went back to the lab", Iris exclaimed impatiently.
ex.cn: “他回实验室去了，”艾里斯不耐烦地大声说。

ex.en: The lab has recently been updated to allow for more advanced courses.
ex.cn: 实验室最近经过更新，可以上更高阶的课程了。

phr.d: 自有品牌；私有品牌；商店自用品牌

ex.en: "Eat before Jul 14" was stamped on the label.
ex.cn: 标签上印着“请于7月14日前食用”。

ex.en: "Eat before JULY 14" was stamped on the label.
ex.cn: 标签上盖有“7月14日前食用”的戳记。

phr.d: 实验室设备；实验室仪器

ex.en: This was demonstrated in a laboratory experiment with rats.
ex.cn: 在实验室用老鼠进行的实验证明了这一点。

ex.en: Potentially dangerous bacteria are regularly sent from one laboratory to another.
ex.cn: 有潜在危险的细菌经常被从一个实验室传到另一个实验室。

ex.en: It was the uncommitted that Labour needed to reach.
ex.cn: 工党需要拉拢的是未表态者。

ex.en: He's been a keen supporter of the Labour Party all his life.
ex.cn: 他一生都是工党的热情拥护者。

ex.en: I am wearing a plaid nightgown trimmed with white lace.
ex.cn: 我穿着一件带有白色蕾丝花边的格子呢睡衣。

ex.en: The nightdress has handmade lace round the armholes and neckline.
ex.cn: 这件女式睡衣的袖孔和领口都镶着一圈手织花边。

ex.en: Despite his lack of experience, he got the job.
ex.cn: 他虽然经验不足，但还是获得了这份工作。

ex.en: Lack of exercise can lead to feelings of depression and exhaustion.
ex.cn: 缺乏锻炼会导致抑郁和疲劳。

phr.d: 企业晋升制度；公司的官阶；公司晋升制度

ex.cn: 她整个身体开始弯曲，搞得梯子倾侧起来。

ex.en: Two men were on the bridge-deck, steadying a ladder.
ex.cn: 两名男子在船桥甲板上扶着一架梯子不让它摇晃。

phr.d: n. 小姐；女士；未婚妻；女朋友
女主角；饰女主角的演员
胖夫人（《哈利波特》里的人物）

ex.en: In the past he dallied with actresses and lady novelists.
ex.cn: 他过去曾与许多女演员和女小说家调情。

ex.en: Listen here, young lady. Don't you call me that!
ex.cn: 你给我听着，小姐。别那样叫我！

phr.d: 滞后时间；时滞；时延；迟延时间

ex.en: As conceit makes one lag behind, so modesty helps one make progress.
ex.cn: 骄傲使人落后, 谦虚使人进步.

ex.en: There's a time lag between infection with HIV and developing AIDS.
ex.cn: 从感染艾滋病病毒到病发有一段滞后期。

phr.d: 最宠爱的人；惟一的宝贝孩子；最珍爱的东西(源自《圣经》)

ex.en: Allow an extra 10-15 min if you prefer lamb well done.
ex.cn: 如果想让羊羔肉完全熟透还需要再煮10到15分钟。

ex.en: I braised some beans to accompany a shoulder of lamb.
ex.cn: 我炖了些豆子，和羊肘子一块吃。

ex.en: He mumbled some lame excuse about having gone to sleep.
ex.cn: 他含含糊糊地找了个蹩脚的借口，想要解释自己为什么睡着了。

ex.en: Scott's muscle atrophied, his leg became stunted, and he was left lame.
ex.cn: 斯科特的肌肉萎缩，一条腿发育不完全，成了个瘸子。

phr.d: 荧光灯；日光灯；荧光灯管

ex.en: I used my thumbnail to tighten the screw on my lamp.
ex.cn: 我用拇指指甲把台灯上的螺钉拧紧了。

ex.en: Eddie parked his cycle against a lamp post and padlocked it.
ex.cn: 埃迪把他的自行车靠在路灯柱上，用挂锁锁好。

phr.d: 土地利用，土地用途；土地使用，土壤使用
土地开发；土地发展；土地建设

ex.en: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
ex.cn: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

ex.en: Harry inherited the house and a sizeable chunk of land.
ex.cn: 哈里继承了这座房子以及相当大的一片土地。

phr.d: 起落架；起落装置，着陆装置

ex.en: The plane had been cleared for landing at Brunswick's Glynco Airport.
ex.cn: 飞机获准降落于不伦瑞克的格林科机场。

ex.en: She has a knack of landing herself right in the soup.
ex.cn: 她老是让自己的处境很尴尬。

ex.en: I heard my landlady creeping stealthily up to my door.
ex.cn: 我听到我的女房东偷偷地来到我的门前.

ex.en: The landlady sighed contentedly.
ex.cn: 房东太太心满意足地叹了口气。

ex.en: He was in an argument with his landlord downstairs.
ex.cn: 他与楼下的房东发生了争执。

ex.en: The landlord refused to serve him because he considered him too drunk.
ex.cn: 酒吧老板觉得他已经喝多了，拒绝再给他添酒。

phr.d: （街道上的）公共汽车专用车道
往事感怀；分隔带车道；人生道路的轨迹

ex.en: The lorry was travelling at 20mph in the slow lane.
ex.cn: 卡车在慢车道上以20英里的时速行驶。

ex.en: Many people are comfortable with life in the slow lane.
ex.cn: 很多人满足于比别人慢半拍的生活。

ex.en: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike.
ex.cn: 达尔文的语言无论对专家还是非专业人士而言都明白易懂。

ex.en: The Ukrainians speak a Slavonic language similar to Russian.
ex.cn: 乌克兰人所说的那种斯拉夫语系的语言类似于俄语。

ex.en: There is an ice lantern show in Harbin every year in winter.
ex.cn: 每年冬天,哈尔滨有一次冰灯展.

ex.en: I've been thinking I'd better have asked for a lantern.
ex.cn: 我一直认为我还不如要一个灯笼呢.

phr.d: 赤鱲角（俗称赤腊角，香港西部海域的一个岛屿）
游泳比赛中一次来回所需之时间

ex.en: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
ex.cn: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

ex.en: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
ex.cn: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

phr.d: 详尽的；未被捕的，整个的

ex.en: Wind turbines are large and noisy and they disfigure the landscape.
ex.cn: 风力涡轮机个头大、噪音响，还会破坏周边风景。

ex.en: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves.
ex.cn: 这些大机构总是随意制定规定，而且说变就变。

ex.en: It is a part of Britain as yet largely unaccustomed to tourists.
ex.cn: 英国的这一块地方还很不为游客所熟悉。

ex.en: Any calls for a new UN resolution are largely political posturing.
ex.cn: 任何要求联合国出台新决议的呼吁在很大程度上都只是一种虚伪的政治姿态。

phr.d: 激光技术；雷射技术；激光工艺

ex.en: Ophthalmic surgeons are now performing laser surgery to correct myopia.
ex.cn: 眼科医生现在采用激光手术来矫正近视。

ex.en: He made contact with someone with an idea for reconditioning laser copiers.
ex.cn: 他联系了一个会修理激光复印机的人。

ex.en: She ran away with a man called McTavish last year.
ex.cn: 去年，她和一个叫麦克塔维什的男人私奔了。

ex.en: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
ex.cn: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

phr.d: 在那天稍晚些时候；[口]为时太晚，失时机

ex.en: Stay in bed extra late or get up specially early.
ex.cn: 起床过晚或过早。

ex.en: He defected from the party in the late 1970s.
ex.cn: 他在20世纪70年代后期叛出了该党。

ex.en: They've really been kicking ass lately — busting places up, harassing everybody.
ex.cn: 他们最近真是让人气不打一处来，闹得天翻地覆，搅得每个人都不得安宁。

ex.en: Lately, the president has been sacking and picking new ministers at whim.
ex.cn: 最近，总统一时兴起频频解雇旧部长，选任新部长。

phr.d: adv. 后来；稍后；过些时候

ex.en: At a later news conference, he said differences should not be dramatized.
ex.cn: 在后来的新闻发布会上，他说不应夸大分歧。

ex.en: I hate to rush you but I have another appointment later on.
ex.cn: 我真不想催你，但我稍后还有一个约会。

ex.en: In his latter years religious mania clouded his mind.
ex.cn: 晚年的时候，对宗教的狂热让他丧失心智。

ex.en: He holds the belief that he is a latter-day prophet.
ex.cn: 他深信自己是当代先知。

phr.d: v. 笑在最后；取得最后胜利

ex.en: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
ex.cn: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

ex.en: Do not hesitate to laugh at anything you find amusing.
ex.cn: 只要觉得好笑就尽管笑。

phr.d: 又哭又笑;欢乐与悲伤[亦作 tears and laughter]
捧腹大笑；笑得直不起腰

ex.en: Behind the mocking laughter lurks a growing sense of unease.
ex.cn: 嘲笑声的背后潜伏着一种越来越强烈的不安。

ex.en: They heard a bottle being smashed, then more raucous laughter.
ex.cn: 他们听见酒瓶摔碎的声音，然后是一阵更喧闹的笑声。

下水日期；发行日期；上市日期

ex.cn: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。

ex.cn: 非洲国民大会打算在全国范围内发起招募运动。

phr.d: 洗衣服务；爱情洗礼（专辑名称）

ex.en: She could ring for food and drink, laundry and sundry services.
ex.cn: 她可以打电话点餐，叫人来取要洗的衣服以及叫其他各种服务。

ex.en: He'd put his dirty laundry in the clothes basket.
ex.cn: 他会把自己的脏衣服扔进洗衣篮里。

ex.en: Is there any lavatory in this building?
ex.cn: 这座楼里有厕所 吗 ?

ex.en: There's a bathroom and a lavatory upstairs.
ex.cn: 楼上有浴室和卫生间。

phr.d: n. 根据法律，在法律上；附则

ex.en: He remembered mowing the lawn, lounging around the swimming pool.
ex.cn: 他还记得修剪草坪、在泳池边闲荡的情景。

ex.en: The windows overlooked a lawn of tall waving grass.
ex.cn: 窗户外边是一块草地，高高的草随风摇摆。

ex.en: The lawyer looked impassively at him and said nothing.
ex.cn: 律师面无表情地看着他，什么都没说。

ex.en: "He was a lawyer before that," Mary Ann put in.
ex.cn: “在那之前他是个律师，”玛丽·安补充道。

phr.d: 奠定基础；奠基；打下基础
涂抹（颜料等）；猛攻；加…于人
展示；安排；花钱；为…划样；提议

ex.en: On Sunday Cohen lay around the house all day.
ex.cn: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。

ex.en: Under the newspaper, atop a sheet of paper, lay an envelope.
ex.cn: 在报纸下面的一张纸上放着一个信封。

ex.en: Sensitive Cream will not strip away the skin's protective layer.
ex.cn: 敏感肌肤专用面霜不会破坏皮肤表面的保护层。

ex.en: It was hard to see the colours under the layer of dust.
ex.cn: 蒙了一层灰尘后颜色就很难看清了。

ex.en: The layout should be clear and easy on the eye.
ex.cn: 版式应该清晰悦目。

ex.en: This boat has a good deck layout making everything easy to operate.
ex.cn: 这艘船的甲板布局合理，使得所有操控都很方便。

phr.d: （餐桌上盛食物便于取食的）圆转盘
锤出吊货法；吊柱间绳索；吊杆稳索

ex.en: "Yous two are no 'gettin' paid," he said. "Ye're too lazy!"
ex.cn: “你们两个别指望拿到工钱，”他说。“你们太懒了！”

ex.en: Lazy and incompetent police officers are letting the public down.
ex.cn: 懒惰兼无能的警官令公众失望。

n. 提前期；订货至交货的时间；研制周期；交付周期

ex.en: Politicians say it could lead to a dissolution of parliament.
ex.cn: 政客们说这可能会导致议会解散。

ex.en: The group proceeded with a march they knew would lead to bloodshed.
ex.cn: 这个团体继续示威游行，他们知道这将导致流血事件的发生。

phr.d: 组长；车间班长；团体领袖

ex.en: He doesn't feel he is cut out to be a leader.
ex.cn: 他认为自己没有做领导的才能。

ex.en: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
ex.cn: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

phr.d: 领导技巧；领导技能；领导艺术

ex.cn: 但有人担心，共和党的领导层可能会在该协议上出现意见分歧。

ex.en: Britain needs new leadership if she is to help shape Europe's future.
ex.cn: 如果英国想要对欧洲未来的发展产生重要影响的话，就需要新的领导层。

phr.d: 前沿；居领先优势；最先着风的帆缘
龙头企业；（行业中的）龙头老大

ex.cn: 两家很有名的律师事务所准备向烟草公司提起诉讼。

ex.en: The Democratic candidate is still leading in the polls.
ex.cn: 民主党候选人的得票数依然领先。

phr.d: 有叶子的；叶茂的；长满叶子的

ex.cn: 我像风中的落叶一样浑身发抖。

ex.en: Fortunately, the chore of leaf sweeping is well worth the effort.
ex.cn: 幸运的是，干清扫落叶这个活儿是值得的。

长春藤联盟；长春藤名牌大学

ex.cn: 他的投球在大联盟的击球员中是个传奇。

ex.en: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
ex.cn: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

phr.d: 漏气；空气渗漏；空气泄漏

ex.en: A hydrogen leak forced NASA to ground the space shuttle.
ex.cn: 氢气泄漏迫使美国国家航空航天局停止了航天飞机的发射。

ex.en: The yacht has sprung a leak in the hull.
ex.cn: 帆船的船体上出现了一条裂缝。

ex.en: She was feeling tired and was glad to lean against him.
ex.cn: 她正感到有些疲倦，因此很高兴可以靠在他身上。

ex.en: Lean the plants against a wall and cover the roots with peat.
ex.cn: 把植物靠墙摆放，用泥煤盖住根部。

大跃进（中国于1958～1960年执行的经济计划）

ex.cn: 沃里克队在排名中蹿升至第3名，落后领先的埃塞克斯队31分。

ex.en: The scale of migration took a quantum leap in the early 1970s.
ex.cn: 20世纪70年代初，移民的规模骤然扩大。

phr.d: 做事；学会做某事；学习做…

ex.en: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
ex.cn: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

phr.d: 经验教训；教训总结；取得的教训

ex.en: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value.
ex.cn: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

ex.en: I learned a lot from him about how to run a band.
ex.cn: 我从他那里学到了许多关于经营乐队方面的东西.

phr.d: n. 高等教育；高深学问；（电影名称）校园大冲突
高等学校；高等教育机构

ex.cn: 他仍旧处在学习阶段，一旦驾轻就熟后将势不可挡。

ex.en: Without continued learning, graduates will lose their intellectual vitality.
ex.cn: 如果不继续学习，毕业生就会失去思想上的活力。

phr.d: 最小二乘法；最小平方法
最小二乘法，最小二乗法

ex.cn: 每天尽量至少吃4片面包。

ex.en: He is the least appealing character, to me at any rate.
ex.cn: 他是其中最没有吸引力的角色，至少对我来说是这样。

ex.en: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger.
ex.cn: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

ex.en: He drummed his fingers on the leather top of his desk.
ex.cn: 他用手指连续敲击他的皮革桌面。

ex.en: It got to the point where he had to leave.
ex.cn: 到了他不得不走的地步。

ex.en: One more question and I'll leave you in peace.

ex.cn: 对于现况的不满，不能只是抱怨，要有作出改变。

ex.en: His people came up with a load of embarrassing information.
ex.cn: 他的部下亮出一大堆令人尴尬的资料来。

ex.en: I've never heard such a load of tripe in all my life.
ex.cn: 我一辈子还从没听到过这样一堆废话。

ex.en: The proposal could put 3p on a loaf of bread.
ex.cn: 这项提议会使每个面包的成本增加3便士。

ex.en: The cost of a loaf of bread has increased five-fold.
ex.cn: 一条面包的价钱增长了4倍。

ex.en: Now is the time to touch him for a loan.
ex.cn: 现在是向他借笔钱的时候了。

ex.en: The President is also expected to request a rescheduling of loan repayments.
ex.cn: 预计总统还会要求延长借款偿还期限。

phr.d: 地方政府；[总称]地方政府官员（或工作人员）
区域网络，局部网络；本地网络；市话网络

ex.en: Global ecological efforts can easily be at odds with local ecologies.
ex.cn: 全球性生态保护工作很可能会和地方生态系统存在矛盾。

ex.en: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
ex.cn: 今天地方选举的投票一开始就人头攒动。

phr.d: 在某一点设置；在…定居；坐落于

ex.en: We've simply been unable to locate him.
ex.cn: 我们就是没办法找到他。

ex.en: Try to locate exactly where the smells are entering the room.
ex.cn: 找找看气味具体是从什么地方散入房间的。

phr.d: 运算位置， 操作位置

ex.en: The location has been changed at the last minute.
ex.cn: 在最后一刻改变了地点。

ex.en: The first duty of a director is to recce his location.
ex.cn: 主管的第一项任务是熟悉所在地区的情况。

ex.en: She shrugged a stray lock of hair out of her eyes.
ex.cn: 她把一缕散发从眼前甩开。

ex.en: He picked each lock deftly, and rifled the papers within each drawer.
ex.cn: 他熟练地撬开每一把锁，把每个抽屉里的文件都偷走了。

phr.d: 机车发动机；机车蒸汽机

ex.en: He was killed by an onrushing locomotive.
ex.cn: 他被飞驰而来的火车头撞死了。

ex.en: The Locomotive Construction Company Ltd is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Trust.
ex.cn: 机车建筑有限公司是该托拉斯的全资子公司。

ex.en: Authorities requisitioned hotel rooms to lodge more than 3,000 stranded Christmas vacationers.
ex.cn: 当局征用旅馆房间安顿了3,000多名无处落脚的圣诞度假者。

ex.en: I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's lodge.
ex.cn: 我驶出大门，经过守门人的小屋。

phr.d: (木材)未经斧削的；处于原木状态的
象木头一样不动；无知觉的

ex.en: In the evening a log fire would provide cosiness.
ex.cn: 晚上点起篝火会让人感到温暖舒适。

ex.en: Customers pay to log on and gossip with other users.
ex.cn: 顾客付费后登录系统和其他用户聊天。

ex.en: Apart from criminal investigation techniques, students learn forensic medicine, philosophy and logic.
ex.cn: 除罪案调查技巧外，学生们还要学习法医学、哲学和逻辑学。

ex.en: By now all logic had gone out of the window.
ex.cn: 到这时根本就不讲什么逻辑了。

ex.en: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.
ex.cn: 不容置疑的事实是，电脑执行逻辑操作指令。

ex.en: The key to his success is his logical mind.
ex.cn: 他成功的关键在于他擅长逻辑思维。

phr.d: 孤独的心；感到孤独的人

ex.en: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
ex.cn: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

ex.en: Miserable, and unexpectedly lonely, she went in search of Jean-Paul.
ex.cn: 内心痛苦、突感寂寞的她去寻找琼－保罗。

phr.d: adj. 长期的（持久的）；长时间；好久好久

ex.en: The road to peace will be long and drawn-out.
ex.cn: 通往和平的道路将很漫长。

ex.en: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.
ex.cn: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。

ex.en: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
ex.cn: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

ex.en: She had the look of someone deserted and betrayed.
ex.cn: 她一副遭人遗弃和背叛的样子。

phr.d: 环形系统，环状管网；闭合系统

ex.en: These activists don't want to feel out of the loop.
ex.cn: 这些活跃分子不想做局外人。

ex.en: I think that the vice president was in the loop.
ex.cn: 我认为副总统是局内人。

phr.d: 释放；使随心所欲；屈服；突然倒塌
vt. 摆脱；割断；不受约束，自由行动；逃跑；狂欢

ex.en: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
ex.cn: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

ex.en: She gathered loose soil and let it filter slowly through her fingers.
ex.cn: 她捧起疏松的泥土，任其缓缓地从指间漏下。

phr.d: 放松肌肉；松弛；[口]信口开河；[口]慷慨解囊

ex.en: Relax, smile; loosen up in mind and body and behaviour.
ex.cn: 放松，微笑。精神、身体和行为上都要放轻松。

ex.en: Loosen the bolt so the bars can be turned.
ex.cn: 松一松插销，好转动门闩。

phr.d: 耶和华；万军之主（等于上帝）
对…作威作福，对…称王称霸；向…逞威风；对…摆架子

ex.en: A few days earlier he had received a telegram from Lord Lloyd.
ex.cn: 几天前，他收到劳埃德勋爵发来的一封电报。

ex.en: "Good lord, that's what he is: he's a policeman."
ex.cn: “我的天哪，他原来是警察呀。”

phr.d: 货车吊机；机动式起重吊车

ex.en: He looked straight ahead and overtook a lumbering lorry.
ex.cn: 他眼睛直视前方，加速超过了前面一辆慢吞吞行进的大卡车。

ex.en: They used a lorry to ram the main gate.
ex.cn: 他们用卡车猛撞大门。

phr.d: 耽误时间；走得慢；失去时机

ex.en: Some battles you win, some battles you lose.
ex.cn: 胜败乃兵家常事。

ex.en: He appealed to his countrymen not to lose heart.
ex.cn: 他呼吁自己的同胞不要丧失信心。

ex.en: He always woke with a sense of deep sorrow and depressing loss.
ex.cn: 他醒来时总是满怀哀愁，抑郁惆怅。

ex.en: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
ex.cn: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

phr.d: 经常和…在一起；经常见到

ex.en: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
ex.cn: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

ex.en: I got quite a lot of ribbing from my team-mates.
ex.cn: 队友们经常开我的玩笑。

phr.d: 搞什么名堂（不耐烦的一种表现）；哎呀（生气时的叹词）
扩音器，扬声器；增高话音

ex.en: There was a loud thump as the horse crashed into the van.
ex.cn: 马撞在货车上发出砰的一声巨响。

ex.en: Mr Jones received loud support from his local community.
ex.cn: 琼斯先生获得了他所在社区民众的热烈支持。

ex.en: I distinctly heard the loudspeaker calling passengers for the Turin-Amsterdam flight.
ex.cn: 我清楚地听到扩音器里在请都灵至阿姆斯特丹航班的旅客登机。

ex.en: Announcements were made over the loudspeaker system.
ex.cn: 通知通过喇叭广播。

ex.en: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
ex.cn: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

ex.en: If you love life, life will love you back.
ex.cn: 热爱生活，生活也会厚爱你。(Arthur Rubinstein)

ex.en: Sweden is lovely in summer— cold beyond belief in winter.
ex.cn: 瑞典的夏天非常宜人——冬天却冷得让人难以置信。

ex.en: It was just one of those lovely old English gardens.
ex.cn: 那正是一个那种古老的英式花园，非常迷人。

ex.en: She was dumped by her long-term lover after five years.
ex.cn: 5年后她被相恋多年的恋人抛弃了。

ex.en: He tried to throw police off the track of his lover.
ex.cn: 他努力让警方无法跟踪他的情人。

ex.en: Doctor believed that his low sperm count was the problem.
ex.cn: 医生认为他的精子数太低是问题所在。

ex.en: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
ex.cn: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
ex.cn: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

ex.en: Basal metabolism is much lower for creatures in cold water.
ex.cn: 冷水中生物的基础代谢速度要低很多。

ex.en: He has 20 years of loyal service to Barclays Bank behind him.
ex.cn: 他已经忠心耿耿地为巴克莱银行效力了20年。

ex.en: I thanked them for their long and loyal service.
ex.cn: 我感谢他们长期以来忠诚的效力。

ex.en: Loyalty and support became the bywords of the day.
ex.cn: 忠诚和支持成了那个时代人们时常挂在嘴边的词儿。

ex.en: There were too many other demands on his loyalty now.
ex.cn: 现在还有太多其他的事情也要求他忠心。

phr.d: 为了图吉利；为了祈求好运

ex.en: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
ex.cn: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

ex.en: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
ex.cn: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

ex.en: I'm lucky really as I never put on weight.
ex.cn: 我很幸运，因为我的体重从来没有增加过。

ex.en: Chantal was lucky to be able to salvage her career.
ex.cn: 尚塔尔能保住她的事业算是走了运。

ex.en: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
ex.cn: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

ex.en: He waited until all the luggage was cleared, but Paula's never appeared.
ex.cn: 他一直等到所有的行李都拿走了，但始终没看见葆拉的。

ex.en: The truck was sent to carry lumber.
ex.cn: 卡车被派出去运木材.

ex.en: It was made of soft lumber, spruce by the look of it.
ex.cn: 其制作材料是软木，看起来像是云杉。

phr.d: 整笔付款；一次总算，一次总付
混合价格；总括价格；整笔计价格

ex.en: They used to buy ten kilos of beef in one lump.
ex.cn: 他们过去常买10公斤重的整块牛肉。

ex.en: Howard had to have cancer surgery for a lump in his chest.
ex.cn: 霍华德不得不进行肿瘤手术以切除胸部的肿块。

ex.en: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
ex.cn: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

ex.en: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair.
ex.cn: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

phr.d: 牛肺疫，牛传染性胸膜肺炎

ex.en: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
ex.cn: 吸烟导致每年有1万人死于慢性肺病。

ex.en: Lung cells die and are replaced about once a week.
ex.cn: 肺细胞约每周新老更替一次。

ex.en: The spa is the last word in luxury and efficiency.
ex.cn: 这家矿泉疗养浴场极尽奢华，功效极高。

ex.en: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
ex.cn: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

phr.d: [建]切削机，切割机；裁切机，裁剪机；截煤机；下料压力机

ex.en: Planes dropped bombs and raked the beach with machine gun fire.
ex.cn: 飞机投下炸弹，并用机关枪扫射海滩。

ex.en: Parents can programme the machine not to turn on at certain times.
ex.cn: 父母可以设定这台机器的程序，使它在特定时间段无法开启。

phr.d: n. 疯牛病；牛绵状脑病
变的恼怒，发火；变得着迷
n. 自备的零钱；女子备急用的钱

ex.en: She's not as mad about sport as I am.
ex.cn: 她不像我对体育那么痴迷。

ex.en: There are certain things he does that drive me mad.
ex.cn: 他的某些举动让我很生气。

phr.d: 尊敬的先生或女士（信笺的开头语）

ex.en: Dear Madam, Thank you for your interest in our Memorial Scheme.
ex.cn: 尊敬的女士，感谢您对我们的纪念方案的关注。

ex.en: Sue is a thoroughly precocious little madam if ever there was one.
ex.cn: 休确实是个少见的早熟的小丫头。

phr.d: 商业类杂志；行业性杂志；专业杂志

ex.en: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
ex.cn: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

ex.en: She presents a monthly magazine programme on the BBC.
ex.cn: 她在英国广播公司主持一个月刊节目。

phr.d: n. 奥兰多魔术队（美国篮球队名称）

ex.en: There is no magic formula for producing winning products.
ex.cn: 获奖电影的制作没有捷径可取。

ex.en: It infected them with some of the magic of a lost age.
ex.cn: 逝去的岁月让他们平添了几分魅力。

ex.en: Open wounds act like a magnet to flies.
ex.cn: 裸露的伤口很招苍蝇。

ex.en: In the 1990s the area became a magnet for new investment.
ex.cn: 这个地区在20世纪90年代成了新的投资热点。

phr.d: 磁选；磁性分离；磁力分离；磁力选矿

ex.en: The secondary current sets up a magnetic field inside the tube.
ex.cn: 二次电流在管子内部会产生磁场。

ex.en: The mineral is weakly magnetic.
ex.cn: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

ex.en: Originally released in 1957, the film was remade as "The Magnificent Seven".
ex.cn: 这部电影最早在1957年上映，后被翻拍为《七侠荡寇志》。

ex.en: At 54 years old her energy and looks are magnificent.
ex.cn: 她54岁了，精力和气色都非常好。

phr.d: n. 老处女；[口]谨小慎微的人

ex.en: The maid looked at him, a nervous smile on her face.
ex.cn: 女服务员看着他，脸上带着一丝局促不安的微笑。

ex.en: They had a butler, a cook, and a maid.
ex.cn: 他们有一个男管家、一个厨师和一个女佣。

phr.d: 邮寄；通过写信，通过邮递；按信件
每日邮报（英国伦敦的报刊）

ex.en: Goods may be sent by surface mail or airmail.
ex.cn: 货物可通过平寄或空运发送。

ex.en: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
ex.cn: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

phr.d: 主体，主要部分；主船体；机身

ex.en: They used a lorry to ram the main gate.
ex.cn: 他们用卡车猛撞大门。

ex.en: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.
ex.cn: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。

ex.en: She was going to Nanaimo to catch the ferry to the mainland.
ex.cn: 她准备去纳奈莫乘渡船回大陆。

ex.en: The island may be reached by boat from the mainland.
ex.cn: 这个岛屿可以从大陆乘小船到达。

ex.en: Our survey revealed that these allergies were mainly one-offs.
ex.cn: 我们的调查显示这些过敏多为一次性反应。

ex.en: Thousands of people, mainly Zulus, assembled in a stadium in Thokoza.
ex.cn: 数以千计的人，主要是祖鲁族人，聚集在托考查的一个体育场里。

ex.en: The government was right to maintain interest rates at a high level.
ex.cn: 政府维持高利率的做法是正确的。

ex.en: In New Zealand, the Maori people maintain a strong cultural tradition.
ex.cn: 在新西兰，毛利人保持着深厚的文化传统。

ex.en: In the future the machines will need spare parts and maintenance.
ex.cn: 这些机器将来会需要备件和维修保养。

ex.en: She did none of the maintenance on the vehicle itself.
ex.cn: 她对车子本身没有进行半点养护。

ex.en: He said the issue was not a major irritant.
ex.cn: 他说那个问题不是什么大问题。

ex.en: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
ex.cn: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

ex.en: Independent candidates won the majority of seats on the local council.
ex.cn: 无党派候选人在地方议会选举中赢得了多数席位。

ex.en: It's possible the Congress Party will scrape together a majority.
ex.cn: 国大党可能会勉强获得多数票。

ex.en: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves.
ex.cn: 这些大机构总是随意制定规定，而且说变就变。

ex.en: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
ex.cn: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

phr.d: 雄性不育；男性不育；雄性不育性；男性不育症

ex.en: The army is still one of the last male bastions.
ex.cn: 军队仍然是男人占据的最后堡垒之一。

ex.en: We were in the same college, which was male-only at that time.
ex.cn: 我们那时在同一所学院，当时只招男生。

phr.d: 没有人；[口]老喜欢唱反调的人（等于no-man）

ex.en: She ran away with a man called McTavish last year.
ex.cn: 去年，她和一个叫麦克塔维什的男人私奔了。

ex.en: Nora was deflowered by a man who worked in a soda-water factory.
ex.cn: 在汽水厂工作的一个男子夺去了诺拉的童贞。

phr.d: 挣扎做某事；设法完成某事
没有…而仍设法对付过去

ex.en: We'll manage somehow, you and me. I know we will.
ex.cn: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。

ex.en: Petroleum engineers plan and manage the extraction of oil.
ex.cn: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

ex.en: Increasingly, corporate clients are seeking to outsource the management of their facilities.
ex.cn: 越来越多的公司客户寻求将设施的管理外包出去。

ex.en: The governors were joined by Mr Hunter and his management team.
ex.cn: 亨特先生及他率领的管理小组加入了州长们的队伍。

phr.d: 基金经理，财务经理；基金管理人

ex.en: I want the manager'sjob when he calls it a day.
ex.cn: 等到经理不干了之后，我想接替他的位子。

ex.en: I wouldn't lay bets on his still remaining manager after the spring.
ex.cn: 我看他的这个经理当不到春天之后了。

ex.en: His research is for the betterment of mankind.
ex.cn: 他的研究是为全人类造福。

ex.en: Mankind's knowledge of the universe has increased beyond measure.
ex.cn: 人类对于宇宙的了解已经大为增加。

ex.en: He set himself manly tasks and expected others to follow his example.
ex.cn: 他给自己定下了男子汉的任务，并希望别人效之。

ex.en: The boy walked with a confident manly stride.
ex.cn: 这男孩以自信的男人步伐行走.

phr.d: 在某种意义上；在某种程度上
adj. 各种各样的；形形色色的（人，东西等）

ex.en: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
ex.cn: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

ex.en: Cross was a little taken aback by her abrupt manner.
ex.cn: 她鲁莽的态度让克罗斯感到有点吃惊。

phr.d: 安装手册，操作工序说明书；工艺规范

ex.en: Too often he only absorbs half the information in the manual.
ex.cn: 他对于说明书上所说的经常是一知半解。

ex.en: The worst part of the set-up is the poor instruction manual.

ex.cn: 医生们列举了大量病人被逐出医院的实例。

ex.en: Scientific development meant the growth of numerous professions ancillary to medicine.
ex.cn: 科技发展意味着许多医学衍生职业的增长。

ex.en: We're going to go home and nurse our colds.
ex.cn: 我们打算回家调养感冒。

ex.en: "Can you walk all right?" the nurse asked him.
ex.cn: “你走路有困难吗？”护士问他。

ex.en: We have started a campaign for better nursery and school services.
ex.cn: 我们已发起一场要求改善幼儿园和中小学教育服务的运动。

ex.en: Local authority nursery provision covers only a tiny minority of working mothers.
ex.cn: 当地政府提供的保育服务只有少数上班族母亲才能够享受到。

phr.d: [英国口语](前常与 can’t 连用)一点也，根本

ex.en: The Daily Express describes Dr Carey as a pretty tough nut.
ex.cn: 《每日快报》把凯里医生说成是特别难对付的家伙。

ex.en: Getting out there is in many ways the hardest nut to crack.
ex.cn: 从很多方面来说，出去交际是最难以做到的事了。

phr.d: 锦纶丝；尼龙丝；尼龙丝线

ex.en: When it's dry, brush the hair using a soft, nylon baby brush.
ex.cn: 当头发干后，用柔软的婴儿用尼龙发刷梳理头发。

ex.en: I slowly zipped and locked the heavy black nylon bags.
ex.cn: 我慢慢地把那些沉重的黑色尼龙袋的拉链拉上并锁好。

phr.d: 橡树岭（美国田纳西州东部城市）

ex.en: He was a huge man, built like an oak tree.
ex.cn: 他是个大块头，结实得像棵橡树。

ex.en: The wind was bouncing the branches of the big oak trees.
ex.cn: 一棵棵高大橡树的枝条随风摇摆。

ex.en: Kent must be kept out of this affair. He'll interfere and tries to have an oar in everyman's boat.
ex.cn: 这事可不能让肯特参与. 他一定会横加干涉,乱管闲事.

ex.en: An oar often acts as rudder.
ex.cn: 桨常可起舵的作用.

ex.en: They obey the one unwritten rule that binds them all—no talking.
ex.cn: 他们都遵守着那条约束他们所有人的默认规则——要守口如瓶。

ex.en: Clifford's only stipulation is that his clients obey his advice.
ex.cn: 克利福德唯一的要求就是客户必须听从他的建议。

phr.d: 面向对象的；对象趋向的；物件导向的
被控对象，受控对象；控制对象

ex.en: He made it his object in life to find the island.
ex.cn: 他把找到那座岛屿当成自己的人生目标。

ex.en: He thought of the baby almost as an inanimate object.
ex.cn: 他认为婴儿几乎就是毫无生命的物体。

ex.en: I no longer have any objection to your going to see her.
ex.cn: 我不会再因为你去见她而不高兴。

ex.en: Some managers have recently raised objection to the PFA handling these negotiations.
ex.cn: 一些主教练最近就英格兰职业足球运动员协会负责这些谈判提出了异议。

ex.en: I believe that a journalist should be completely objective.
ex.cn: 我认为新闻记者不应当有丝毫偏见。

ex.en: His objective was to kill the space station project altogether.
ex.cn: 他的目的是使空间站项目全面停止。

ex.en: Please oblige me with a reply as soon as possible.
ex.cn: 请尽早给予答复.

ex.en: Mr Oakley always has been ready to oblige journalists with information.
ex.cn: 奥克利先生总是乐于向记者透露消息。

ex.en: The diaries are a mixture of confession and observation.
ex.cn: 这些日记既有自白，也有评论。

ex.en: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.
ex.cn: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。

ex.en: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
ex.cn: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

ex.en: Scientists observe the same dynamics in fluids.
ex.cn: 科学家们在液体中观察到了同样的驱动力。

ex.en: The current sole superpower is far from being a disinterested observer.
ex.cn: 当前唯一的超级大国远不是一个公正的旁观者。

ex.en: There is a lengthy article on Spike Milligan in the Observer newspaper.
ex.cn: 《观察家报》上有一篇关于斯派克·米利根的长篇文章。

ex.en: A lack of qualifications can be a major obstacle to finding a job.
ex.cn: 学历不足可能成为谋职的主要障碍。

ex.en: A further obstacle has presented itself, however.
ex.cn: 然而，突然又出现了一个障碍。

phr.d: 获得信息；索取资料或合同

ex.en: Only with mass direct action will we obtain such change.
ex.cn: 只有采取大规模直接行动，我们才会取得这样的改变。

ex.en: Gregory'sfather had implanted in him an ambition to obtain an education.
ex.cn: 格雷戈里的父亲早就向他灌输了要接受教育的志向。

ex.en: She persevered in her idea despite obvious objections raised by friends.
ex.cn: 虽然朋友们明确反对，她还是坚持己见。

ex.en: The ideological divisions between the parties aren't always obvious.
ex.cn: 政党之间的意识形态界线并不总是泾渭分明的。

ex.en: She was very glum and was obviously missing her children.
ex.cn: 她郁郁寡欢，显然在惦念自己的孩子们。

ex.en: Now, erm, obviously some of our listeners may have some ideas.
ex.cn: 嗯，对了，显然我们的一些听众可能会有些想法。

phr.d: 特别的时刻；特别的场合
adj. 有一次；曾经， 有一个时候

ex.en: On one occasion, his father threw a radio at his mother.
ex.cn: 他父亲曾有一次拎起收音机砸向他的母亲。

ex.en: The good weather helped to make the occasion a resounding success.
ex.cn: 天公作美，使得这次活动获得了巨大成功。

ex.en: She saw the occasional glimmer of a moth's wings.
ex.cn: 她看见蛾子的翅膀偶尔会泛光。

ex.en: An elegant occasional table is framed in the window.
ex.cn: 一张雅致的供重大活动使用的餐桌被摆放在橱窗里。

ex.en: His prose is vigorous and dense, occasionally to the point of obscurity.
ex.cn: 他的散文文笔有力、内容庞杂，有时几近晦涩。

ex.en: Occasionally a patient is so debilitated that he must be fed intravenously.
ex.cn: 偶尔会有病人过于虚弱，必须通过静脉注射进食。

ex.en: Intellectual life in France was smothered by the occupation.
ex.cn: 在被占领期间法国思想界受到了压制。

ex.en: Social status is largely determined by the occupation of the main breadwinner.
ex.cn: 社会地位很大程度上是由家里经济支柱的职业决定的。

ex.en: U.S. forces now occupy a part of the country.
ex.cn: 美国军队现在占领了该国的一部分。

ex.en: This challenge will occupy Europe for a generation or more.
ex.cn: 这将是欧洲在未来二三十年或者更长的时间里所要面临的挑战。

ex.en: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
ex.cn: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。

ex.en: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
ex.cn: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

ex.en: The greatest occurrence of coronary heart disease is in those over 65.
ex.cn: 65岁以上者是冠心病的最高发人群。

ex.en: For months at a time, air raids were a nightly occurrence.
ex.cn: 一度有几个月，每天晚上都会发生空袭。

ex.en: His abiding passion was ocean racing, at which he scored many successes.
ex.cn: 他一直酷爱海上赛艇，并多次在比赛中获胜。

ex.en: It became impractical to make a business trip by ocean liner.
ex.cn: 乘坐远洋班轮进行商务旅行变得不合时宜了。

phr.d: 出人意料互不相配的一对

ex.en: He smiled, an odd, dreamy smile that sent chills up my back.
ex.cn: 他笑了，笑容古怪迷离，叫我后背发凉。

ex.en: How odd life was, how unfathomable, how profoundly unjust.
ex.cn: 生活多么离奇，多么莫测，多么不公啊！

ex.en: The plant has an unpleasant odour and an acrid taste.
ex.cn: 这种植物闻着刺鼻，吃着辣口。

ex.en: He was acutely aware of the odour of cooking oil.
ex.cn: 他闻到一股浓浓的油烟味。

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: Generosity is its own form of power.
ex.cn: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

ex.en: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
ex.cn: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

ex.en: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
ex.cn: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

ex.en: There can be little doubt that he will offend again.
ex.cn: 毋庸置疑他还会再犯的。

ex.en: I try to offend the least amount of people possible.
ex.cn: 我尽量少得罪人。

ex.en: Leningrad was the third alien city to offer him a surrogate home.
ex.cn: 列宁格勒是他在异地安家的第三个外国城市。

ex.en: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
ex.cn: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

ex.en: His office was in keeping with his station and experience.
ex.cn: 他的办公室与其身份和阅历相称。

ex.en: One of the office girls was down with the flu.
ex.cn: 一位女职员得了流感。

ex.en: He was returned to prison in 1977 for impersonating a police officer.
ex.cn: 他1977年因冒充警官而再次入狱。

ex.en: Secret Service officer Robin Thompson spoke on behalf of his colleagues.
ex.cn: 特工处官员罗宾·汤普森代表他的同僚发表了讲话。

ex.en: You simply can't get a ticket through official channels.
ex.cn: 通过官方渠道是压根儿搞不到票的.

ex.en: The official number of people carrying the AIDS virus is low.
ex.cn: 艾滋病病毒携带者的官方数字并不高。

ex.en: Students often travel hundreds of miles to get here.
ex.cn: 学生常常赶数百英里的路来到这里。

ex.en: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
ex.cn: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

ex.en: The policeman smiled at her. "Pretty dog."— "Oh well, thank you."
ex.cn: 警察冲她笑了笑，“这狗真漂亮。”——“哦，谢谢。”

ex.en: He goes to me: "Oh, what do you want?"
ex.cn: 他问我：“哦，你想要什么？”

phr.d: 重油（将焦油蒸馏得到的比重大于水）

ex.en: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
ex.cn: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

ex.en: Check the oil at regular intervals, and have the car serviced regularly.
ex.cn: 定期检查汽油，并对车辆进行定期维护。

ex.en: "Are you okay?" I asked. She nodded and smiled.
ex.cn: “你没事吧?”我问她.她点点头,笑了.

ex.en: "I think I hear the telephone ringing."—"Okay, I can take a hint."
ex.cn: “我想我听到电话铃在响。”——“好的，我明白你的意思了。”

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: As a group, today's old people are still relatively deprived.
ex.cn: 整体而言，当今的老年人依然相对贫困。

ex.en: Please don't omit to lock the door when you leave.
ex.cn: 离开时不要忘了锁门.

ex.en: I'll not wish to omit this valuable book from my reading.
ex.cn: 我可不愿在自己的阅读书目中漏掉这本有价值的书.

ex.en: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
ex.cn: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

ex.en: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
ex.cn: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

ex.en: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
ex.cn: 这里曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

ex.en: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
ex.cn: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

phr.d: （将来）有一天；总有一天；（过去）某一天
adv. 成为一体；[口]只试一次
举个例说；作为其中一个

ex.en: I have $100m hidden away where no one will ever find it.
ex.cn: 我把1亿美元藏到了一个永远没人会找到的地方。

ex.en: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
ex.cn: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

ex.en: The doll-like figures in these stories are unlike anybody, let alone oneself.
ex.cn: 这些故事中的玩偶形象跟谁都不像，更不用说像自己了。

ex.en: It is a very rewarding exercise to work this out oneself.
ex.cn: 独自解决这个问题是一次受益匪浅的锻炼。

phr.d: 葱；（英）大葱；生吃的小洋葱

ex.en: Fry for about 4 minutes, until the onion has softened.
ex.cn: 煎4分钟左右，直到洋葱变软。

ex.en: Mix the meat with the onion, carrot, and some seasoning.
ex.cn: 把肉和洋葱、胡萝卜及一些佐料搅拌在一起。

phr.d: 直到那时（后面的句子要倒装）

ex.en: The arteries are diseased and a transplant is the only hope.
ex.cn: 动脉已经发生病变，移植是唯一的希望。

ex.en: His house was the only settled home I had as a child.
ex.cn: 他的房子是我儿时唯一固定的家。

ex.en: So, if we could just move onto something else?
ex.cn: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

ex.en: Drop the dough onto a baking sheet with a teaspoon.
ex.cn: 用茶匙把生面团舀到烤盘上。

phr.d: 打开；开发；开始；展示，揭露
空地；休憩用地；露天场所

ex.en: Without warning, Bardo smacked his fist into his open hand.
ex.cn: 巴多没有任何预兆地一拳砸在自己摊开的手掌上.

ex.en: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
ex.cn: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

phr.d: 开放，扩大开放；疏通，打通；开发矿山
开学典礼；开幕式；开幕仪式；开幕典礼
开盘价；按开市价盘；开盘指令；开盘委托
（图书馆）开放时间；（书店）营业时间

ex.en: He flipped through the post without opening any of it.
ex.cn: 他飞快地翻了一下邮件，但一封也没有打开。

ex.en: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.
ex.cn: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。

phr.d: 肥皂剧（以家庭问题为题材的广播或电视连续剧）

ex.en: The following year she joined the Royal Opera House.
ex.cn: 次年她加入了皇家歌剧院。

ex.en: Young conductors earn their spurs in a small orchestra or opera house.
ex.cn: 年轻的指挥家们在小乐队或小歌剧院里崭露头角。

phr.d: 操作方式，运算方式；工作状态

ex.en: Hotels operate a collection service for their guests from the airports.
ex.cn: 宾馆为客人提供机场接机服务。

ex.en: Trains will operate from Waterloo with a pick-up stop at Ashford.
ex.cn: 火车从滑铁卢站出发，途中会在阿什福德站停靠上人。

ex.en: The formalization of co-operation between the republics would produce progress.
ex.cn: 正式确立合作关系将会促进共和国之间合作的顺利进展。

ex.en: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
ex.cn: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

phr.d: 操作风险；经营风险；运作风险

ex.en: The new airport is now fully operational .
ex.cn: 新机场现在可全面投入运营。

ex.en: Exports have not been halted completely because another line is operational.
ex.cn: 出口并没有完全停止，因为另一条生产线还能运转。

phr.d: 网络运营者；网路操作者；网络算子
旅行社；包价旅游承办商

ex.en: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.
ex.cn: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。

ex.en: I became a ham radio operator at the age of eleven.
ex.cn: 我在11岁时成了一名业余无线电操作员。

phr.d: adv. 依我看来，在我看来

ex.en: He will have been heartened by the telephone opinion poll published yesterday.
ex.cn: 他会为昨天公布的电话民意调查结果感到鼓舞。

ex.en: And what of the effect on U.S domestic opinion?
ex.cn: 对美国国内的舆论有什么影响？

ex.en: Young and old saw in him an implacable opponent of apartheid.
ex.cn: 无论老少都看出他是种族隔离制度的坚决反对者。

ex.en: The president put the blame squarely on his opponent.
ex.cn: 总统将责任完全归咎于对手。

ex.en: The opportunity had gone. His mind scrabbled for alternatives.
ex.cn: 机会已经失去。他苦苦思索别的方案。

ex.en: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
ex.cn: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

ex.en: This party would bitterly oppose the re-introduction of the death penalty.
ex.cn: 本党会强烈反对恢复死刑。

ex.en: It is illogical to oppose the repatriation of economic migrants.
ex.cn: 反对把经济移民遣送归国是不合逻辑的。

ex.en: The argument contained herein takes exactly the opposite point of view.
ex.cn: 本文所持的论点恰恰是站在相反的立场。

ex.en: A string of five rowing boats set out from the opposite bank.
ex.cn: 5只划艇排成一行从对岸出发了。

ex.en: The imperialists exploit and oppress all the peoples of the world.
ex.cn: 帝国主义者剥削和压迫全世界人民.

ex.en: He states uncompromisingly that he is opposed to any practices which oppress animals.
ex.cn: 他坚决声明反对任何虐待动物的行为。

phr.d: 光学显微镜；光学显微术；光学显微学

ex.en: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
ex.cn: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

ex.en: The camera combines rugged reliability with unequalled optical performance and speed.
ex.cn: 这款相机既坚固耐用，又有超凡的光学性能和快门速度。

ex.en: They are not optimistic about a settlement of the eleven year conflict.
ex.cn: 他们不是很有信心能和平解决这场长达11年的纷争。

ex.en: Before his first round of discussions, Mr Baker sounded an optimistic note.
ex.cn: 第一轮讨论前，贝克先生听上去还比较乐观。

phr.d: 出售选择权；卖出选择权；卖出期权
n. 期权合约；选择权契约

ex.en: It is thought that a management buyout is one option.
ex.cn: 管理层收购被认为是一种选择。

ex.en: It is not an unattractive option to make programmes for other companies.
ex.cn: 为其他公司制作节目也不失为一个好的选择。

ex.en: Optional extras include cooking tuition at a top restaurant.
ex.cn: 可选的额外项目包括在顶级餐厅学习厨艺。

ex.en: We also recommend a full day optional excursion to the Upper Douro.
ex.cn: 我们还推荐去杜罗河上游的短途自选一日游。

ex.en: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think.--Dale Carnegie
ex.cn: 请记住，幸福不在于你是谁或者你拥有什么，而仅仅取决于你的心态！

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: I spoke privately to the candidate after the oral.
ex.cn: 口试后，我私下里与那位考生谈了谈。

ex.en: The story of King Arthur became part of oral tradition.
ex.cn: 亚瑟王的故事成为口头传说的一部分。

ex.en: He moved around the country working in orange groves.
ex.cn: 他在乡村不断换工作，为不同的柑橘园干活。

ex.cn: 法辛巷刚好在大街的北面，与大街平行。

ex.cn: 亲鸟开始为幼鸟寻找食物。

ex.cn: 现在很多孩子在单亲家庭中出生或成长。

ex.cn: 停车场被人挤得水泄不通。

ex.cn: 他说议会和民主程序已遭贬值。

ex.cn: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

ex.cn: 我偏爱加有新鲜水果的精致油酥甜点。

ex.cn: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

ex.cn: 这实际上是剥夺了他们正式参与选举的权利。

ex.cn: 这个国家一半以上的人口参加体育锻炼。

ex.cn: 她讲的没有一句实话.

ex.cn: 质子是物质的基本粒子。

ex.cn: 共和党的战略家正尖锐地攻击民主党的参议员。

ex.cn: 我们被教导要以特定的方式理解这些词语。

ex.cn: 涂抹染发剂可能会搞得一团糟，特别是长发。

ex.cn: 接触食物前尤其对洗手不能有半点马虎。

ex.cn: 下降的部分原因在于英镑对美元的升值。

ex.cn: 一个生意伙伴曾将账单交给汉普顿代为保管。

ex.cn: 然后你的搭档应该将球回传给你。

ex.cn: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

ex.cn: 他一生都是工党的热情拥护者。

ex.cn: 他面无表情地站在那里，听法官宣布判决。

地下通道；地底通道；地下道

ex.cn: 走廊里的煤气灯应该是开着的，调得比较暗。

ex.cn: 《人权法案》通过已经200年了。

ex.cn: 我们大多数航班行李限重为每位乘客44磅。

ex.cn: 是艾伦为这场较量注入了激情。

ex.cn: 她需要并想要被爱的滔滔激情和倾慕所包围。

ex.cn: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。

ex.cn: 她讨厌扮演那些漂亮可爱、消极被动的女人，观众们已把她定型为这类角色。

ex.cn: 出国度假需持有效护照。

ex.cn: 在肉上切出深深的口子，再把辣酱塞进切口中。

ex.cn: 用打蛋器将蛋黄和糖打成均匀的糊状。

ex.cn: 这家公司的主管们觉得他值得栽培。

ex.cn: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了1分多。

ex.cn: 整体而言，当今的老年人依然相对贫困。

ex.cn: 到1973年，政府财政赤字相当于国民生产总值的30%。

ex.cn: 他像英格兰人那样将它读成Per-sha。

ex.cn: 投票者认为他是一位坚定果断的国际领导人。

ex.cn: 通货膨胀率大约为2.7%。

ex.cn: 它是以百分比的形式表示的。

ex.cn: 学工科的女孩的比例已经大大增加了。

ex.cn: 他们称划船是最佳运动，它可以锻炼每一处主要肌肉群。

ex.cn: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

ex.cn: 这个乐队演奏灵歌和福音音乐的变奏曲。

ex.cn: 他能表演好几种令人惊叹的把戏，包括哑剧和玩杂耍。

ex.cn: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

ex.en: They siphon foreign aid money into their personal bank accounts.
ex.cn: 他们把国外救济金非法转入了个人银行账户。

ex.en: My personal life has had to take second place to my career.
ex.cn: 我的私人生活不得不让位于事业。

phr.d: 保修人员；服务行业人员

ex.en: I looked your address up in the personnel file.
ex.cn: 我在人事档案里找到了你的地址。

ex.en: Embassy security personnel refused to admit him or his wife.
ex.cn: 使馆保安人员不允许他和夫人进入。

ex.en: It's the collision of disparate ideas that alters one's perspective.
ex.cn: 是迥然不同的观点之间的碰撞改变了人们的看法。

ex.en: The Telegraph puts the union in a historical perspective.
ex.cn: 《电讯报》从历史的角度对该工会进行了报道。

ex.en: Somehow, he'd managed to persuade Kay to buy one for him.
ex.cn: 不知用了什么方法，他成功说服凯给他买了一个。

ex.en: Eisenhower used his muscle to persuade Congress to change the law.
ex.cn: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

ex.en: They appeared surprisingly pessimistic about their chances of winning.
ex.cn: 他们对胜利的可能性显得出奇地悲观。

ex.en: Hardy has often been criticised for an excessively pessimistic view of life.
ex.cn: 哈代由于对生活持过度悲观的态度而常常受到批评。

phr.d: 宠物商店，玩赏动物商店
不能忍受的事；经常抱怨的问题

ex.en: They would sell the meat off as pet food.
ex.cn: 他们将把肉当作宠物食品卖掉。

ex.en: Make sure your pet won't pine while you're away.
ex.cn: 要确保不在家时宠物不会想你。

phr.d: 汽油发动机；汽油机；柴油引擎

ex.en: The crowds became violent and threw petrol bombs at the police.
ex.cn: 人群变得狂暴起来，并向警察投掷汽油弹。

ex.en: There's no petrol, so it's very difficult to transport goods.
ex.cn: 没有汽油，因此很难运输货物。

ex.en: Petroleum engineers plan and manage the extraction of oil.
ex.cn: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

ex.en: The purpose of oil refinery is to refine crude petroleum.
ex.cn: 炼油厂的主要工作是提炼原油.

phr.d: 两相的；二相；二相的；双相的

ex.en: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
ex.cn: 实际上写作过程中最重要的阶段是修改。

ex.en: The crisis is entering a crucial, critical phase.
ex.cn: 目前危机正进入决定性的关键阶段。

ex.en: This phenomenon is not as outrageous as it seems.
ex.cn: 这种现象并不像它看上去那样骇人。

ex.en: It's an interesting scientific phenomenon, but of no practical use whatever.
ex.cn: 这是一种有趣的科学现象，但没什么实用价值。

ex.en: He is a teacher by occupation but a philosopher by inclination.
ex.cn: 他的职业是教师,但他的本心是成为哲学家.

ex.en: the Greek philosopher Aristotle
ex.cn: 希腊哲学家亚里士多德

ex.en: They asked her some searching questions on moral philosophy and logic.
ex.cn: 他们深入询问了她一些有关伦理学和逻辑学的问题。

ex.en: Apart from criminal investigation techniques, students learn forensic medicine, philosophy and logic.
ex.cn: 除罪案调查技巧外，学生们还要学习法医学、哲学和逻辑学。

ex.en: I took the phone, and she went discreetly into the living room.
ex.cn: 我拿起了电话，她知趣地进了客厅。

ex.en: Rather taken aback by such forwardness, I slammed down the phone.
ex.cn: 如此无礼的言语让我火冒三丈，我砰的一下把电话挂了。

ex.en: The popular papers all have photo features on their inside pages.
ex.cn: 通俗报纸的内页都有照片专栏.

ex.en: They said, after digging around, the photo was a fake.
ex.cn: 在搜集了有关情况后，他们说照片是伪造的。

ex.en: He'd like to go on safari to photograph snakes and tigers.
ex.cn: 他想进行一次观兽旅行，拍摄一些蛇类和老虎的照片。

ex.en: He tore down the girl's photograph, and crumpled it into a ball.
ex.cn: 他一把扯下那女孩的照片，将它揉成一团。

ex.en: The phrase was not meant to be taken seriously.
ex.cn: 此话不必当真。

ex.en: A phrase from the conference floor set my mind wandering.
ex.cn: 会上发言者的一句话让我思绪飘远。

phr.d: n. 体育；体能训练；身体训练
身体健康；体力；身体适宜性

ex.en: Character is not separable from physical form but is governed by it.
ex.cn: 性格和外表是分不开的，而且观其形知其性。

ex.en: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
ex.cn: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

ex.en: I'm a practicing physician trying to help people here and now.
ex.cn: 我是一名此时此刻只想治病救人的执业医师。

ex.en: I committed the physician's cardinal sin: I got involved with my patients.
ex.cn: 我犯了从医的大忌：跟病人有了感情纠葛。

ex.en: I think he's a physicist or something of that nature.
ex.cn: 我想他大概是物理学家或那一类的人.

ex.en: He is a physicist of the first rank.
ex.cn: 他是一流的物理学家.

ex.en: Physics isn't just about pure science with no immediate applications.
ex.cn: 物理学并非只是一门不能直接运用的纯科学。

ex.en: On balance, the book is a friendly, down-to-earth introduction to physics.
ex.cn: 总而言之，这是一本通俗而务实的物理入门书。

ex.en: The piano music mixes with the murmur of conversation.
ex.cn: 钢琴的弹奏声混杂着低低的交谈声。

ex.en: He started piano lessons at the age of 7.
ex.cn: 他7岁开始上钢琴课。

phr.d: [用以加强语气，尤指人群关系]谨慎选择

ex.en: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
ex.cn: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

ex.en: See our selection of autumn favourites and take your pick.
ex.cn: 看看我们的秋季精选，然后挑出你想要的。

ex.en: I took the kids for a picnic in the park after school.
ex.cn: 放学后我带孩子们去公园野餐。

ex.en: They were tidying up the remains of their picnic.
ex.cn: 他们正在收拾野餐后剩下的东西。

phr.d: 是…的化身；与…非常相像；十足…的样子
照相；落井钻具顶部打模
大图像；重点；（事情的）主要部分；特种宽银幕电影

ex.en: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.
ex.cn: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

ex.en: The Sun had captioned a picture of Princess Diana "Princess of Veils"
ex.cn: 《太阳报》在黛安娜王妃的一张照片下写了一段说明文字——“披着面纱的王妃”。

phr.d: 南瓜（馅）饼，番瓜饼；南瓜派
不能保证实现的诺言；渺茫的希望
用鹿等动物内脏做的馅饼；屈辱

ex.en: He can't help thinking it's all just "pie in the sky" talk.
ex.cn: 他禁不住想所有这些不过是“画饼充饥”的空话而已。

ex.en: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
ex.cn: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

phr.d: 工作物；半制品；被加工件
轻而易举的事情；轻松愉快的事
难事；一件作品；一项工作

ex.en: That's a beautiful piece of work. You should be proud of it.
ex.cn: 那件作品非常漂亮，你应当为之自豪。

ex.en: How very thoughtless. I'll give him a piece of my mind.
ex.cn: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

phr.d: 皮尔斯·布鲁斯南（美国电影演员）

ex.en: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
ex.cn: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

ex.en: Producers decided to end her on-screen romance with Pierce Lawton.
ex.cn: 制片人决定结束她在影片中与皮尔斯·劳顿的恋情。

phr.d: adv. 永无可能；决不可能

ex.en: "A talking pig!" he exclaimed. "Well, I'll be darned."
ex.cn: “一只会说话的猪!”他大声叫道，“哎呀，真是怪事。”

ex.en: I'm afraid I made a pig of myself at dinner.
ex.cn: 恐怕我晚餐时吃得太多了。

ex.en: A pigeon emerges, wings flapping noisily, from the tower.
ex.cn: 一只鸽子从塔里钻出来，扑扑地拍打着翅膀。

ex.en: I don't care where the money comes from — that's not my pigeon.
ex.cn: 我不管钱从哪儿来,那不是我的事.

phr.d: 螺旋钻孔桩；填充桩；螺旋桩

ex.en: The entire pile shifted and slid, thumping onto the floor.
ex.cn: 那整整一摞东西动了一下后滑落下来，嘭的一声全掉到了地上。

ex.en: On the table beside an empty plate was a pile of books.
ex.cn: 桌上空盘子的旁边是一堆书。

phr.d: 毒药丸（比喻公司为避免被对方兼并而向对方索取极高代价的阻挠措施）

ex.en: The pill is the most efficient method of birth control.
ex.cn: 服用避孕药是最有效的避孕方法。

ex.en: She had been on the pill for three years.
ex.cn: 她吃口服避孕药已有3年。

phr.d: ◎(无目的地)从一处到另一处；东奔西跑

ex.en: He was a pillar of the club for over thirty years.
ex.cn: 30多年来他一直是这个俱乐部的顶梁柱.

ex.en: She strove to read the name on the stone pillar.
ex.cn: 她费劲地读着石柱上的名字。

phr.d: 开口式枕套；无边式枕套
（小孩在临睡前在卧室内用枕头）打闹；小争吵

ex.en: Sam snuggled down in his pillow and fell asleep.
ex.cn: 萨姆舒服地枕着枕头进入了梦乡。

ex.en: I have a pillow with my name embroidered on it.
ex.cn: 我有一个绣着我名字的枕头。

phr.d: 试点项目，试点工程；样板工程，样板设计
n. 初步研究；预备试验；飞行员研究
n. 试验工场；小规模试验厂
试点计划，试点工程；实验计画

ex.en: The pilot wisely decided to return to Farnborough post haste.
ex.cn: 飞行员明智地决定尽快返回法恩伯勒。

ex.en: The minutes towards departure ticked by, until finally the pilot arrived.
ex.cn: 离出发的时间越来越近，最后飞行员终于到了。

phr.d: 如坐针毡；焦躁不安；手脚发麻
[口语]把某事的责任加上某人身上，把某事归罪于某人

ex.en: It has taken until now to pin down its exact location.
ex.cn: 直到现在才确定了它的准确位置。

ex.en: She'd do anything for a bit of pin money.
ex.cn: 为了挣点外快，她什么都肯做。

phr.d: [化]夹点（饱和蒸气与冷却剂最小温差点）

ex.en: Pinch-hitter Francisco Cabrera lashed a single to left field.
ex.cn: 替补队员弗朗西斯科·卡布雷拉向左外场猛地击出一个一垒打。

ex.en: Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of cayenne.
ex.cn: 调以盐、胡椒和少许辣椒粉。

ex.en: Make sure your pet won't pine while you're away.
ex.cn: 要确保不在家时宠物不会想你。

ex.en: A thrush alighted on a branch of the pine tree.
ex.cn: 一只鸫落在松树的树枝上。
